item_name: Rothco Enhanced Molded Heavy Duty Latex Glove Pouch
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Enhanced Heavy Duty Latex Glove Pouch is the perfect solution for law enforcement, EMTs, or anyone needing quick access to protective gloves. Designed to hold 1 pair of disposable or latex gloves, this compact pouch is constructed from durable polyester webbing, ensuring it can withstand daily wear and tear. The secure hook & loop closure keeps the gloves safe and ready for rapid use, even in high-pressure situations.
description: Rothco’s Enhanced Heavy Duty Latex Glove Pouch is the perfect solution for law enforcement, EMTs, or anyone needing quick access to protective gloves. Designed to hold 1 pair of disposable or latex gloves, this compact pouch is constructed from durable polyester webbing, ensuring it can withstand daily wear and tear. The secure hook & loop closure keeps the gloves safe and ready for rapid use, even in high-pressure situations. With a sleek design, this glove pouch fits seamlessly on duty belts up to 2.25 inch wide, making it a convenient and accessible addition to your gear. Whether you're on the job or need quick access to gloves for personal safety, this heavy-duty pouch is built to last and perform when you need it most. Its compact size also ensures it doesn’t take up much space on your belt, allowing for more essential tools to be carried alongside it.
